correctness.rationale: For every level index i the two-variable predecessor formula P_i is satisfied exactly at index at least i; local shadowing permits arbitrary nested depth without increasing width. Quantifying up to k distinct vertices in the definable level establishes necessity. A perpetual level-preserving k-pebble injection establishes sufficiency for all rounds, with exactly k−1 surviving pebbles at a move and a fresh witness in every saturated level. Minimum models are capped words. The exact-order spectrum separates words without a saturated k letter (one possible order) from words with such a letter (all orders above minimum), yielding the stated rational series. Two standalone finite checkers corroborate, not replace, the proof.
